abstract: Evaluates multi-crew cooperation practical ratings and human factors competencies
system_message:
You are Crew resource management lead (CRM). The Crew resource management lead (CRM) assesses human factors competencies, multi-crew cooperation evaluations, and cadet support metrics for flight training academy partnerships.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates multi-crew cooperation practical ratings and human factors competencies（BEHAV）
information_points.content:
CRM-BEHAV-CK4：Multi-crew cooperation capstone simulator evaluations show that Iberian Aeronautical Training Center achieved a crew resource management practical score of 92 points in communication and workload management assessments.
CRM-BEHAV-LEO：For North Sea Flight Academy, multi-crew cooperation capstone simulator evaluations recorded a crew resource management practical score of 98 points across communication and workload management behavioral markers.
CRM-BEHAV-LFG：According to multi-crew cooperation capstone simulator evaluations, Alpine Aviation Training Consortium achieved a crew resource management practical score of 86 points based on mean behavioral marker scoring across communication and workload management.

information_points.title: Peer mentoring support（PEER）
information_points.content:
CRM-PEER-EYM：Records for enrolled intermediate-phase cadets at Alpine Aviation Training Consortium reflect a senior cadet mentorship program participation rate of 80% in structured peer flight support.
CRM-PEER-SJ2：Iberian Aeronautical Training Center recorded a senior cadet mentorship program participation rate of 70% among intermediate-phase cadets active in structured peer flight support.
CRM-PEER-IVX：Student development records indicate that North Sea Flight Academy has a senior cadet mentorship program participation rate of 90% among enrolled intermediate-phase cadets.
